title: FIFA World Cup 2026: Complete Guide for Sri Lankan Fans
byline: Get ready for the FIFA World Cup 2026 with this essential guide on the new 48-team format, groups, and North American venues. We break down the match schedule and IST timings specifically for Sri Lankan fans to help you plan your late-night viewing. From ticket prices to team debuts, find everything you need to follow the world’s biggest football tournament from Sri Lanka.

title: Prices to be revised at eateries using LAUGFS Gas
byline: The Restaurant Owners Association has announced a revision of food and beverage prices at eateries using LAUGFS Gas, citing rising operational costs driven by increased LPG prices.

title: Rabies vaccine shortage would increase human fatalities
byline: The Government Medical Officers’ Association (GMOA) has raised serious concerns over an alleged shortage of rabies vaccines at Medical Officer of Health (MOH) offices across the country, warning that the disruption could lead to a dangerous rise in rabies infections among animals and an increase in human fatalities.

title: Research vessel Dr. Fridtjof Nansen completes marine survey in Sri Lankan waters
byline: The Research Vessel Dr. Fridtjof Nansen has successfully completed a marine scientific survey in Sri Lankan waters and departed Colombo, marking the conclusion of a key mission aimed at strengthening the country’s ocean knowledge base.

title: South Korean envoy seeks improved bureaucratic efficiency in trade facilitation
byline: South Korean Ambassador Miyon Lee emphasized yesterday that Sri Lanka should concentrate on upgrading its trade facilitation system while identifying the sequencing.

title: Deniyaya meningitis situation under watch
byline: Health authorities have ruled out the risk of a major viral meningitis outbreak in Deniyaya for now, while continuing to closely monitor the situation following a rise in suspected infections among schoolchildren.

title: Rajangane Saddharathana Thera arrested
byline: Rajangane Saddharathana has been arrested by the Central Crime Investigation Bureau (CCIB), police said.

title: Trump says US-Iran ceasefire still in place after exchange of fire in Strait of Hormuz
byline: US President Donald Trump says a ceasefire is still in place between the US and Iran after both sides exchanged fire late on Thursday night. It was unclear who fired first.

title: Former SriLankan Airlines CEO found dead
byline: Former Chief Executive Officer of SriLankan Airlines, Kapila Chandrasena, was found dead at his residence in Kollupitiya under suspicious circumstances, police said.

title: Aloysians launch new rugby jersey
byline: St. Aloysius’ College Galle officially launched its 2026 school rugby season on Wednesday with a special ceremony held at the school auditorium to unveil the team’s new official match jersey.

title: Oil prices rise after US and Iran exchange fire in Hormuz strait
byline: Oil prices rose on Friday after the US and Iran exchanged fire in the key Strait of Hormuz waterway.

title: Kapila Chandrasena found dead at cricketer Aravinda de Silva’s residence
byline: Investigations have revealed that Kapila Chandrasena, the former Chief Executive Officer of SriLankan Airlines, was found dead early Friday morning at the residence of legendary Sri Lankan cricketer Aravinda de Silva in Kollupitiya.

title: PCoI urges public to submit any information on coal imports before May 22
byline: The Special Presidential Commission of Inquiry apponted to investigate into the import of coal has informed the public to submit any information held by individuals or institutions regarding matters related to the imports of coal before May 22, 2026.

title: Kollupitiya Police tell court ex-SriLankan Airlines CEO’s death suspicious
byline: Court proceedings at the Fort Magistrate’s Court were postponed for one hour after the Magistrate left the court to conduct a magisterial inquiry into the sudden death of former SriLankan Airlines Chief Executive Officer Kapila Chandrasena.

title: Indonesia rushes to rescue 20 hikers, including 9 Singaporeans, after Mount Dukono eruption
byline: Twenty people, nine of them from Singapore, were reported missing on Friday (May 8) after Mount Dukono on Indonesia’s eastern Halmahera island erupted, spewing a smoke cloud some 10km into the air.

title: Vietnamese President arrives at Sri Lanka Parliament
byline: President of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam and General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam, To Lam, arrived at the Sri Lanka Parliament a short while ago.

title: Sri Lanka–JAAF talks conclude successfully to safeguard Sri Lanka’s garment exports
byline: Discussions between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Joint Apparel Associations Forum (JAAF) aimed at strengthening and safeguarding the country’s garment export sector have been successfully concluded, officials confirmed.

title: Countries track passengers of virus-hit cruise ship
byline: Countries worldwide sought to prevent the further spread of the hantavirus on Thursday, after an outbreak on a cruise ​ship, by tracking those who had disembarked before the virus was detected and anyone who had close contact with them since.

title: Trump gives EU until 4 July to implement trade deal or face ’much higher’ tariffs
byline: The European Union has until 4 July to fully implement its trade deal with the United States or face ’’much higher tariffs’’, US President Donald Trump said on Thursday after a phone call with European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen.

title: Poor classroom performance may be linked to vision problems: Expert
byline: National Eye Hospital Director Dr. Jayaruwan Bandara claimed that many learning difficulties in classrooms may actually be linked to undetected vision problems and urged schoolchildren and parents to take eye health seriously.

title: Around 2,500 Thalassemia patients in Sri Lanka; 45–60 new cases annually: Health Ministry
byline: Sri Lanka currently has around 2,500 registered thalassemia patients, with an additional 45 to 60 children newly diagnosed each year, Non-Communicable Diseases Unit of the Health Ministry Director Dr. Srini Alahapperuma said.

title: Trump says US-Iran ceasefire still in place after exchange of fire in Strait of Hormuz
byline: US President Donald Trump says a ceasefire is still in place between the US and Iran after both sides exchanged fire late on Thursday night. It was unclear who fired first.

title: Magistrate orders arrest of Ven. Hemarathana Thera
byline: The Anuradhapura Magistrate’s Court has issued arrest warrants for the Anuradhapura Atamasthadipathi Ven. Pallegama Hemarathana Thera, and the mother of a 15-year old  girl in connection with an alleged abuse case.

title: Vietnamese President says his country looking for comprehensive partnerships with Sri Lanka
byline: Vietnamese President To Lam, who addressed Parliament, said his country is looking for maritime, air links and links based on IT and communications with Sri Lanka.

title: Viet Nam, Sri Lanka exchange five MoUs
byline: Viet Nam and Sri Lanka signed five Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) covering areas including tourism, security cooperation, religious and cultural affairs, civil and commercial engagement, transport, economic cooperation, as well as science and technology.

title: Kurunegala deputy mayor arrested over bribery deal
byline: The Deputy Mayor of the Kurunegala Municipal Council and a member of the All Ceylon Makkal Congress was arrested over allegations of soliciting a Rs. 3 million bribe from a businessman in exchange for awarding a tender.

title: Kiridi Oya overflow floods around 30 houses in Wellawaya
byline: Around 30 houses in several areas of Wellawaya have been inundated following the overflow of the Kiridi Oya, according to the Monaragala District Disaster Management Centre said.

title: White House hosts Buddhist blessing for US 250th anniversary
byline: A Buddhist blessing ceremony was held at the White House in Washington, D.C. to mark the 250th anniversary of the independence of the United States of America, which was celebrated on May 7.

title: No definite statement can be made on Kapila Chandrasena’s death: Minister
byline: Public Security Minister Ananda Wijepala said that no definite statement can be made at this stage regarding the death of former SriLankan Airlines Chief Executive Officer Kapila Chandrasena.

title: Vijay inches closer to being Tamil Nadu CM as CPI extends unconditional support
byline: After internal deliberations, the Left party handed over an ’’unconditional letter of support for government formation’’ addressed to Tamil Nadu Governor RV Arlekar, party sources said. The CPI has two legislators each in the 234-member assembly.

title: Smoke-emitting vehicles to be blacklisted under new “Emission Eye” programme
byline: Vehicles that fail to comply with maintenance orders issued for excessive smoke emissions will be blacklisted in the Department of Motor Traffic database under a new enforcement programme launched by the Vehicle Emissions Trust Fund.

title: Customs DG Seevali Arukgoda retires after 37 years
byline: Former Director General of Sri Lanka Customs, Seevali Arukgoda, has officially retired from service after completing 37 years at the department.

title: Kavindu Pathiratne’s all-round brilliance knocks loudly on SLC’s door
byline: The recently concluded National Super League (NSL) four-day tournament may have crowned Team Dambulla as champions, but it was the emergence of all-rounder Kavindu Pathiratne that stole the spotlight and strengthened his case for national recognition.

title: ICC Women’s POTM nominees for April 2026 announced
byline: Standout performers from South Africa, Sri Lanka and Brazil are in the running following exceptional displays across formats during the month of April.

title: Heavy showers, severe lightning to continue over several provinces
byline: The prevailing showery condition across the island is expected to continue over the next few days due to a low-level atmospheric disturbance in the vicinity of Sri Lanka, the Department of Meteorology said.
